terms.definition: The flow of electric charge through a path — electrons in motion.
terms.function: Carries the charge, the brightness, and the energy around every circuit.
terms.whereItIs: The streaming dots inside the clear wire.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the 'how much moves' number on every device label.

terms.definition: The unit of current; one ampere is one coulomb of charge per second.
terms.whyItMatters: The amp rating governs chargers, fuses, and wires.

terms.definition: Current only flows when the path is unbroken from battery back to battery.
terms.whyItMatters: It's why switches and breakers work — break the loop, kill the current.
terms.whereItIs: The removable break segment on the wire.

terms.definition: The pairing where higher current through the bulb makes it glow brighter.
terms.whyItMatters: Brightness, ammeter, and flow all tell the same truth.
terms.whereItIs: The bulb rising and falling with the slider.
